author: Gordon Thelander
releaseNotes:
Test build 1.8.7. Installs alongside the release version; your existing install is untouched.

FIXED (again): the 1.8.6 fix for the raw scan-start error ('Unexpected token <, "<!DOCTYPE" is not valid JSON') did not actually cover every case. The endpoint the Scan button calls had no error handling at all - if starting a scan threw for any reason, Hubitat's own platform rendered an HTML error page, sometimes with a success (200) status, which slipped straight past the check added in 1.8.6. That endpoint now always answers with real JSON, success or failure, so a scan that cannot start reports why instead of crashing the page trying to read HTML as data. Reported by JimB, still failing identically on 1.8.6.

Reports welcome on the community thread.
